definitions.explanation: The part of a roof that projects beyond the wall of a building.

examples.japanese: {軒|のき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{雨|あま}だれ→雨垂れ：15557_amadare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちている→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: Raindrops are falling from the eaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軒下|のきした}→軒下：07850_nokishita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雨宿|あまやど}り→雨宿り：14929_amayadori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I took shelter from the rain under the eaves.

examples.japanese: {軒|のき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{日本家屋|にほんかおく}→日本家屋：noentry⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧。
examples.english: Traditional Japanese houses with deep eaves are cool in summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軒先|のきさき}→軒先：08402_nokisaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{風鈴|ふうりん}→風鈴：09929_fuurin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吊|つ}るした→吊るす：03938_tsurusu⟧。
examples.english: I hung a wind chime from the eaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{軒|のき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連|つら}ねて→連ねる：02080_tsuraneru⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧お⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Small shops stand side by side along the shopping street.

notes:
{軒|のき} refers to the overhanging edge of a roof. Deep eaves are a characteristic feature of traditional Japanese architecture.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{軒下|のきした}→軒下：07850_nokishita⟧ (under the eaves)
- ⟦{軒先|のきさき}→軒先：08402_nokisaki⟧ (edge of the eaves, front of a shop)
- {軒|のき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連|つら}ねる→連ねる：02080_tsuraneru⟧ (to stand in a row, of houses/shops)
- ⟦{雨宿|あまやど}り→雨宿り：14929_amayadori⟧ (taking shelter from rain)

ARCHITECTURAL NOTE:
Deep {軒|のき} in traditional Japanese architecture serve to shade interiors from ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧ sun while allowing winter sunlight to enter.

NOTE: ⟦{軒|けん}→〜軒：01993_ken⟧ is also a counter for houses/buildings.
